lessons.key: ac_gap:verify startup failure paths by running the real binary a unit test of the helper does not prove the dialog or the exit status
lessons.text: Verify startup failure paths by running the real binary; a unit test of the helper does not prove the dialog or the exit status.

lessons.key: weak_test:a check must exercise the function production calls when a fix adds a new entry point replace the old one instead of leaving it covered by the tests
lessons.text: A check must exercise the function production calls; when a fix adds a new entry point, replace the old one instead of leaving it covered by the tests.

lessons.key: weak_test:a test that claims a refused operation leaves a file untouched must compare the file bytes not derived fields
lessons.text: A test that claims a refused operation leaves a file untouched must compare the file bytes, not derived fields.

lessons.key: review_finding:an implementer closing a review round with itself as reviewer does not close the round record the review as pending
lessons.text: An implementer closing a review round with itself as reviewer does not close the round; record the review as pending.
